- Initial release of phy-content-calendar: an automated content calendar generator for social media.
- Creates 2–4 week content plans based on user-defined topic pillars and target platforms.
- Rotates post styles (insight, story, data, contrarian, question, how-to, build update) for variety and engagement.
- Optimizes posting days and frequency for LinkedIn, Reddit, Twitter/X, and HackerNews, following platform-specific best practices.
- Generates draft post outlines and integrates with phy-content-compound to pull relevant content atoms.
- Output supports markdown tables for easy documentation and planning.
